title: test: add three-layer editor quality harness — regression, E2E, and stability gate

commits.message: docs: add Bruce agent harness PR plan

test(electron-demo): add Playwright renderer E2E harness with bridge mock

Adds a five-scenario Playwright harness that validates the Nexus Editor
renderer lifecycle without launching a real Electron process. A typed
window.nexusDemo mock is injected via addInitScript before renderer
scripts run, replacing the contextBridge shim from electron/preload.ts.
All IPC call arguments are recorded in window.__bridgeCalls so tests can
make explicit bridge-contract assertions.

Scenarios covered
- editor-boot: CodeMirror mounts, status shows Untitled
- open-file:   bridge called once, content loaded, status reflects filename
- dirty-state: keyboard input marks document as [modified]
- save:        saveFile invoked with correct path, dirty flag cleared
- search:      Ctrl+F reveals search bar with focused Find input

Supporting changes
- playwright.config.ts: configures Chromium + Vite webServer, CI retries,
  and trace-on-first-retry for debugging flaky runs
- vitest.config.ts: excludes **/e2e/** so vitest does not collect
  Playwright specs (they use a different test runner)
- .gitignore: ignores playwright-report/ and test-results/ artifacts
- pnpm-lock.yaml: adds @playwright/test ^1.49.0 to electron-demo

ci: run renderer e2e harness in PR checks

test(e2e): add stability gate — 3× repeat with retries disabled

Adds test:e2e:stability that runs every renderer scenario three times
sequentially with --retries=0, forming a lightweight flaky-test gate.
Disabling retries is intentional: a deterministic test must pass on its
own; automatic retries would mask nondeterminism rather than surface it.

CI now runs two E2E passes in sequence:
  1. Standard pass  — one run per scenario, retry-on-startup-jitter allowed
  2. Stability pass — three runs per scenario, retries=0, catches flakes

The playwright.config.ts reporter emits a JSON artifact in CI so raw
duration data is preserved for trend analysis without enforcing hard
latency thresholds (CI machine variance makes fixed gates unreliable).
